add-constraint: The pairing check and the widened reason check are added NOT VALID in the statement that adds the two nullable columns, so no rows are scanned under the lock; acquisition is bounded by the 1s lock_timeout, and each constrains only rows inserted from now on.
create-table-references: The foreign keys are created with their new empty table, so no existing rows are scanned while the short catalog lock is held.
row-level-security: Row security is enabled and forced on the new empty table before application code can write it.
create-policy: Policies are catalog-only additions to the new empty table and run under the migration's one-second lock timeout.
